dct_description_sm: A relief map of Yukon showing elevation by hypsometric tints (a gradation of different colours), and spot elevations. Major lakes are also shown. Elevation ranges are included in the map legend. The elevation data were derived from the map Canada-Relief, Fifth Edition, National Atlas of Canada published in 1986.

Cette carte montre le relief (ou l’altitude) du Yukon par rapport au niveau moyen de la mer à l’aide de teintes hypsométriques, (une gradation de couleur représentant les altitudes) et des points cotés.
